description: This file defines the Response class implementing the PSR-7 ResponseInterface, encapsulating HTTP response logic including status codes and reason phrases.

classes.name: Response
classes.description: Represents an HTTP response, including status code, reason phrase, headers, and body, designed to be immutable.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a new response with optional body, status code, and headers.

methods.name: getStatusCode
methods.description: Returns the current HTTP status code.

methods.name: getReasonPhrase
methods.description: Returns the reason phrase associated with the status code.

methods.name: withStatus
methods.description: Returns a new Response instance with the specified status code and reason phrase.

methods.name: setStatusCode
methods.description: Validates and sets the status code and corresponding reason phrase.
